Chapter 1112: Chapter 32 Void and Fierce Sun (Subscription Requested)

The red-clad girl looked at Lin Yuan, with a thousand words in her heart, but ultimately swallowed them all.

“You’re very good.”

The red-clad girl spoke truthfully.

So good that she couldn’t find any faults.

“That’s good to hear.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

At least so far, there hadn’t been any major issues with the Second Layer of his cultivation of “Infinite Void”.

“If the master wants to measure the progress of the internal universe cultivation, you can use this method…”

The red-clad girl began to speak.

“What method?”

Lin Yuan’s eyes brightened a bit.

Whether it’s the First Layer of “Infinite Void”, the Second Layer, or even the Third Layer and Fourth Layer afterwards.

Essentially, it’s about breaking down the most basic constituent particles of the internal universe, and then recombining them in a more complete or even perfect way.

This is also why Lin Yuan had to comprehend over three thousand methods of cosmic construction during the test with the jade gourd.

The essence of “Infinite Void” is to replace the initial construction of the internal universe.

And to ensure internal universe stabilization, during the recombination of the particles at the most microcosmic level of internal universe, everything is done bit by bit.

In other words.

When he fully masters the Second Layer of “Infinite Void”, Lin Yuan cannot determine what stage he has actually reached.

He will only find that the internal universe becomes more and more stable, and its foundation becomes more and more solid.

Until the Second Layer is fully mastered, and the internal universe undergoes its final transformation.

“Please take a look, master.”

The red-clad girl flipped her hand, and a piece of metal several meters in size flew out from the jade gourd.

The surface of this metal had a dark golden hue, faintly emitting an aura of immortality.

“This is Immortal Fine Gold.”

The red-clad girl briefly introduced, “It’s a special material; its only characteristic is hardness, and it’s very hard to destroy.”

“Immortal Fine Gold?”

Lin Yuan carefully examined the piece of dark golden metal not far away.

He had never heard of this type of metal, but since the red-clad girl took it out, it must have originated from the creator of the “Infinite Void” legacy.

It was natural for Lin Yuan not to have heard of it.

“With the foundation of your internal universe, master, if you fully harness the power of the internal universe and suppress this piece of Immortal Fine Gold, as long as you can leave a mark with a depth of half a meter on its surface, then you’re very close to mastering the Second Layer.”

“By then, your internal universe will be considered the strongest under Chaos Stage Perfection.”

The red-clad girl said.

This is the standard she set after assessing the various foundations of Lin Yuan’s internal universe.

Lin Yuan’s internal universe accumulation is much stronger than what is theoretically expected for a cultivator of “Infinite Void”.

The red-clad girl had sensed this as soon as she came in.

Normally, even after absorbing and refining the first seven kinds of liquid in the jade gourd, and with Chaos Void Origin Infusion, it would be hard to have such a vast internal universe upon entering the Twelfth Layer for the first time.

“Only half a meter in depth?”

Lin Yuan looked at the piece of Immortal Fine Gold.

After entering the Ruler Realm, coupled with his recent cultivation in “Infinite Void”.

All aspects of Lin Yuan’s internal universe had surged tremendously.

A new Venerable like the Nine Profound Venerable could be crushed into powder with just a breath if they fell into Lin Yuan’s internal universe.

Before entering the Ruler Realm, the Nine Profound Venerable could still survive even after being enveloped by Lin Yuan’s Physical Body Divine Ability ‘World’, but now it’s basically impossible.

With Lin Yuan’s current foundation, even at the peak of Chaos Realm, it would be difficult to withstand a self-explosion of the internal universe.

But now?

He only needed to leave a half-meter deep mark on this piece of Immortal Fine Gold?

“Let me try.”

Lin Yuan slightly moved his thoughts.

Instantly, the infinite origin within the internal universe began to operate, and the space-time around the dark golden metal started to faintly twist and collapse.

Buzz!

The surface of the dark golden Immortal Fine Gold faintly began to dent, and finally, a mark more than ten centimeters appeared.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan continued to exert the power of the internal universe to suppress, but found that further progress was difficult, let alone leaving more marks.

“The Origin Fine Gold, the deeper it goes, the harder it becomes.”

The red-clad girl on the side said, “You, master, are already doing quite well to leave a ten-centimeter mark on the surface of Origin Fine Gold.”

The red-clad girl was sincerely admiring; a normal internal universe that had just mastered the First Layer of “Infinite Void” couldn’t even leave a one-centimeter mark.

How long has Lin Yuan been cultivating the Second Layer of “Infinite Void”?

“Currently, in terms of internal universe, under Chaos Realm Perfection, there is rarely any life whose internal universe can compare to yours, master, including those wondrous lifeforms.”

The red-clad girl said.

At Chaos Realm Perfection, that is the Great Saint’s Domain, life at this level of Chaos Realm will have a qualitative change, with all aspects surging, including their internal universes.

“Hmm.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

There was still a slight regret in his heart.

If by the standard of Immortal Fine Gold, leaving a half-meter mark meant the internal universe could be considered the strongest under Chaos Realm Perfection.

Then he still had some distance to go compared to the strongest.

“Cultivate, cultivate!”

The true body of Lin Yuan continued to cultivate the Second Layer of “Infinite Void”.

…

Fang Yuan World.

Core defensive line war.

Inside a Class A war machine.

A manifestation of Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“The more I comprehend, the smaller I feel.”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, looking quite contemplative.

The Chaos Secret Patterns contained within the war machine are just a part of the true Chaos Rule. Even a Class A war machine is only a part, although compared to Class B and Class C war machines, this part is much more complete.

“Does surpassing the Chaos Secret Patterns contained in a Class A war machine mean containing a complete Chaos Rule structure?”

Lin Yuan pondered secretly.

War machines beyond Class A can accommodate numerous Great Lord level experts and perfectly integrate the chaotic evolutionary power of multiple Great Lords into one.

The power evolved from the Chaos Rule, which is unique in each case. Every Great Lord’s exclusive chaotic evolutionary power differs, even the same Chaos Flame has countless variations.

Combining all these chaotic evolutionary powers together? How incredible that would be.

“If I could comprehend the Chaos Secret Patterns beyond those contained in a Class A war machine, what would it mean for my understanding of the Chaos Rule…”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head, abandoning the unrealistic thought.

War machines beyond Class A typically appear during all-out wars between the two Ancient Countries.

Such an intense war, with Heavenly Venerates making their moves and the emperor of the Ancient Country overseeing the scene; trying to comprehend war machines beyond Class A? At least it requires the consent of the Ancient Country emperor.

“However, I can already replicate the Chaos Secret Patterns contained in the war machine within the Chaos Void. As long as enough materials are assembled, I can completely replicate a war machine in the Chaos Void.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, realizing that the Red Pine King assumed it would be difficult for him to grasp even the Chaos Secret Patterns of a Class C war machine.

But in fact, in this period, Lin Yuan had comprehended around eighty to a hundred war machine secrets.

He has grasped most of the Chaos Secret Patterns from Class C war machines.

Of course, Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t spread this information externally.

“Hmm?”

Just as Lin Yuan was about to continue comprehending the Chaos Secret Patterns, his heart stirred.

“The Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens Divine Ability imprint, has been fully comprehended?”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

The seventh Physical Body Divine Ability, ‘Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens,’ is undoubtedly the most powerful among the physical body divine abilities awakened by Lin Yuan.

To use this divine ability within the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan devoted most of his mind and effort to comprehending this divine ability.

Even though comprehending these Chaos Secret Patterns is greatly beneficial for enhancing the understanding of the Chaos Rule, Lin Yuan did not go all out and instead focused most of his energy on comprehending the divine ability imprint.

“Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens…”

Lin Yuan finally felt at ease, worried that before comprehending this divine ability, he might suddenly perish and die completely in this Fang Yuan World, preventing this divine ability from being brought to the Chaos Void.

…

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan was cultivating the Second Layer of “Infinite Void.”

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, and strands of power began to intertwine and weave in front of him, eventually forming an incomparably complex and mysterious divine ability imprint.

“This is the Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens Divine Ability?”

Lin Yuan felt delighted, as comprehending the corresponding divine ability imprint meant the physical body divine ability was universally applicable among many true bodies.

“Let’s test if it can be integrated with the inner universe.”

Lin Yuan immediately began to attempt.

Before comprehending the Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens Divine Ability imprint, Lin Yuan had already thought about this.

However, without fully understanding the divine ability imprint, he couldn’t entirely replicate this physical body divine ability, so it remained just a thought and hardly realizable.

But now?

Since the divine ability imprint has been fully understood, he can verify his hypothesis.

“First, try it on a manifestation.”

Lin Yuan did not attempt it within the inner universe of his true body, worrying that if any accident occurred, even with life-saving means, the collapse of the inner universe of the true body would be a significant loss.

Using a manifestation is much more convenient.

Buzz.

Lin Yuan’s mind slightly moved.

A manifestation took form in front of him.

At the same time, the inner universe within the manifestation also began to be established.

However, compared to the inner universe of the true body and the two Primordial Spirits, the inner universe of the manifestation was only equivalent to the peak of the Master Realm.

Woosh.

Within the inner universe of the manifestation, Lin Yuan used the divine ability ‘Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens’ to condense the Fierce Sun Origin, illuminating the entire inner universe.

The next moment.

Under the unprecedented Fierce Sun radiance, the inner universe of the manifestation began rapidly collapsing and destroying.

“Unable to withstand the Fierce Sun Origin?”

Lin Yuan immediately identified the problem; the inner universe established by the manifestation was ultimately too weak.

“Then test on the Primordial Spirit?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that the two Primordial Spirits also cultivated “Infinite Void,” and although not infused multiple times by the Chaos Void Origin, they were stronger than most Chaos Venerables’ inner universes.

“Let’s try it.”

“Even if the inner universe of the Primordial Spirit collapses, the loss isn’t significant.”

Lin Yuan differentiated a consciousness manifestation, descending into the inner universe of the Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

“Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens, condense!”

At once, a cluster of flames appeared, slowly burning and spreading, illuminating every corner.

Rumble.

Along with the constant unfolding of the Fierce Sun Origin.

Observing all this, Lin Yuan’s pupils slightly contracted.
